game: King Arthur and his Round Table

sections.Profile:
The "King Arthur and His Round Table" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1949, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.
